title: Using Titan AI for Crypto Research Without Over-Trusting It
excerpt: Prompt patterns, Sentinel context, and when to stop chatting and open a block explorer.
author: SyNexus Editorial
trustLine: Non-custodial · You sign every trade · Not financial advice.

blocks.text: Instead of 'moon?', ask 'why did this token flag Watch on Aegis?' or 'explain whale concentration on this mint.' Specific prompts get useful, auditable answers.
Titan is the default commander persona — you can rename it in settings. The four Sentinels keep fixed names for consistent lane reporting.
Titan supports read-aloud briefings on supported devices. Pair voice summaries with the written scan so you do not trade on audio alone in noisy markets.
